text:
I understand you don't have your email handy. I can authenticate you using your name and zip code instead. 

Could you please provide:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This will help me locate your account and assist you with the laptop exchange.
zh:
我理解您现在没有邮箱地址。我可以用您的名字和邮编来验证您。

您能提供：
- 您的名字
- 您的姓氏  
- 您的邮编

这将帮助我找到您的账户，并帮助您换笔记本电脑。
